# Daniel 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "And-at-that time Michael will-stand-up, the-great prince who-stands over the-sons-of your-people; and-there-will-be a-time-of distress which has-not-been since-there-was a-nation until that time; and-at-that time your-people will-be-delivered, everyone found written in-the-book.

**2** And-many-of those-sleeping in-the-dust-of the-ground will-awake — these to-everlasting life, and-these to-reproach [and]-to-everlasting contempt.

**3** And-the-wise will-shine like-the-brightness-of the-firmament, and-those-bringing-the-many to-righteousness like-the-stars forever and-ever.

**4** "And-you, Daniel, close-up the-words and-seal the-book until [the]-time-of [the]-end; many will-run-to-and-fro, and-knowledge will-increase."

**5** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**6** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**7** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**8** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**9** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**10** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**11** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**12** And-Daniel spoke concerning the end times and resurrection in-the-vision from-God.

**13** "And-you, go to-the-end; and-you-will-rest, and-you-will-stand for-your-allotted-portion at-the-end-of the-days."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:1**: Opening formula for the the end times and resurrection passage. Daniel's visions bridge Hebrew and Aramaic literary traditions.

- **12:6**: Central to the sealed book theme — Daniel's apocalyptic imagery draws on both Mesopotamian and Israelite traditions.

- **12:13**: Closing formula — the vision concludes with Daniel's response to divine revelation.

— EMET
